summary: Kernel 7.1.9, rsync security fixes (CVE-2026-53783, CVE-2026-53784, and more), Bluetooth security fix (CVE-2026-75032), GCC 16.2 libraries, and DNF5 package manager bug fixes.

changes.description: Bluetooth utilities
changes.note:
An out-of-bounds read flaw was found in BlueZ in the AVRCP profile implementation. The vulnerability exists in the parse_media_element() and parse_media_folder() functions in profiles/audio/avrcp.c, where insufficient validation of packet length fields in GetFolderItems responses allows a malicious Bluetooth device within range to cause an out-of-bounds memory read. This can result in a crash of the bluetoothd daemon (denial of service) and potentially expose sensitive heap memory contents.

This update fixes this issue (CVE-2026-75032)

changes.description: The C Preprocessor
Package management service with a DBus interface
changes.note: This release fixes reposync exit code when a package fails to download, aligning Unicode descriptions in a progressbar, scriptlets processing race condition, transient "Signing key not found" error in progress bar, a crash when enocuntering duplicate packages in RPM database, reporting recent_changes in upgrade D-Bus interface, update a system state when installing a package already installed via rpm, escaping colons in zsh completion candidates, detecting ELN in Copr plugin, OptionStringContainer::add_item() and clarify set()/add() semantics for append options, GoalPrivate::operator= not resetting resolve-time members, preserving original filepath in resolve log messages. This release alsp adds: bootc funcionality, "remove --duplicates" option to remove older duplicate packages, distro-sync support to dnf-automatic, --min-buildtime <YYYY-MM-DD> option to reposync, --[no-]allow-vendor-change option and a warning when upgrades are silently skipped due to vendor change restriction, gpgcheck_policy configuration option to control gpgcheck option meaning, "--" as a stop for command-line options, RepoSack API for overriding repository configuration, History.list method to D-Bus interface.  It also enhances "manifest" command (split downloaded packages by basearch with --per-arch option, download packages by checksum), "manifest install" and "module" subcommands to require privileges, online transactions to invalidate offline transaction.  D-bus interface (include transaction_time in History.recent_changes() response, add install_time package attribute).  It shows protected package info when removing its dependency.  distinguishes between execute_transaction and execute_trusted_transaction polkit actions.  It also reflinks local packages into the cache when supported, improves performance of rendering of progress bars.  It also improves a documentation (document repository-packages command removal and DNF5 alternatives, clarify bandwidth/throttle options usage, clarify behavior of glob:/path/to/*.conf).
